title: Combined machine with a choice branch
statement: Let $N_0$ and $N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet. Their combined machine has the sum of their work-tape counts and state type $	ext{Option}(N_0.	ext{State} \oplus N_1.	ext{State})$, with initial state none. From that state, a choice bit selects the initial state of $N_0$ or $N_1$; thereafter, in either branch, the machine applies the selected machine's transition for that bit to its own work tapes, leaving the other machine's tapes unchanged and embedding successor states in the corresponding summand. The transition out of the initial state leaves the input and work-tape heads stationary, makes no writes or output, and enters the selected initial state.
hypotheses_covered: Two finite nondeterministic Turing machines over Bool
